import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission_null.csv")
submission_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Text cleaning function - handles escape sequences and formatting
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        # Remove surrounding quotes if present
        text = text.strip()
        if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
            text = text[1:-1]
        # Normalize escape sequences to avoid tokenization issues
        text = text.replace("\\n", " ")
        text = text.replace("\\t", " ")
        text = text.replace("\\r", " ")
        text = text.lower().strip()
    return text


# Apply text cleaning to both datasets
print("Cleaning text...")
train_df["Comment_Clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment_Clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Word-level TF-IDF features
print("Vectorizing text with word-level TF-IDF...")
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", lowercase=True
)
X_word_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

# Character-level TF-IDF features
print("Vectorizing text with character-level TF-IDF...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 3), max_features=5000, lowercase=True
)
X_char_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

# Concatenate word and character features
print("Concatenating features...")
X_train = np.hstack([X_word_train.toarray(), X_char_train.toarray()])
X_test = np.hstack([X_word_test.toarray(), X_char_test.toarray()])

# Stratified hold-out validation split
print("Splitting data for validation...")
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Train Logistic Regression with balanced class weights
print("Training Logistic Regression model...")
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    class_weight="balanced", C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
lr_model.fit(X_train_split, y_train)

# Train Gradient Boosting classifier as ensemble partner
print("Training Gradient Boosting model...")
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=5, random_state=42
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_split, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set - ensemble averaging
print("Evaluating ensemble validation AUC...")
lr_val_pred = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
gb_val_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
ensemble_val_pred = (lr_val_pred + gb_val_pred) / 2
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set - ensemble averaging
print("Predicting on test set...")
lr_test_pred = lr_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
gb_test_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
ensemble_test_pred = (lr_test_pred + gb_test_pred) / 2

# Create submission dataframe matching sample_submission format
print("Creating submission...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"],
        "Date": test_df["Date"],
        "Insult": ensemble_test_pred,
    }
)

# Save submission
print("Saving submission...")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with {len(submission_df)} rows.")
